source_note: Manual spot-check comparing OSM-derived GTFS attributes against published operator / HCMC public-transport route disclosures (SaigonBus, FUTA Bus Lines, VinBus, HTX 19/5).

routes.corridor: Bến xe Chợ Lớn – Ga Ba Son
routes.assessment: Within published length range (outbound 10.49 km vs inbound 8.30 km due to one-way downtown streets); OSM reflects post-Metro-1 Ba Son terminus; peak bound 8 min vs published 5 min.

routes.corridor: Bến xe Quận 8 – Đại học Quốc gia
routes.assessment: +3.5 to +4.5% longer than published (+1.2–1.5 km): OSM maps 5.80 km (outbound, rel/17376396: 34.31 km) and 5.31 km (inbound, rel/17376397: 34.01 km) of internal VNU-HCM (ĐHQG) campus loops and terminal turnaround ways, plus 0.14 km of duplicate ways on outbound. Hours and 4–15 min headway match.

routes.corridor: Bến xe Sài Gòn – KCX Linh Trung – ĐH Quốc gia
routes.assessment: +5% longer than ~28 km published corridor (29.73 km outbound vs 29.03 km inbound) due to internal ĐHQG loop ways; outbound OSM relation had 1 out-of-order way fixed during way-sum computation; OSM interval (8–12 min) is narrower than published 6–15 min.

routes.corridor: Đại học Bách khoa – Đại học Quốc gia
routes.assessment: +11.3% longer (+3.0 km) than SaigonBus's ~26.5 km figure: outbound rel/17428226 (30.08 km) and inbound rel/17431068 (29.01 km) differ by 1.07 km on one-way approaches and include extended internal ĐHQG Khu A / KTX / Bách khoa CS2 campus loops (5.85 km outbound, 7.03 km inbound) with appended/reordered terminal stops and 0.22 km duplicate outbound ways. Outbound interval (15–25 min) matches official; inbound retains stale 10–30 min tag. Duration missing on OSM (published ~65 min).

routes.corridor: Bến xe Chợ Lớn – Bến xe Miền Đông mới
routes.assessment: +1.4% length difference (26.71 km outbound vs 27.21 km inbound); OSM tags peak 10–15 min band only (omits 15–20 min off-peak band), showing OSM headway can slightly overstate off-peak frequency.
